description: The Xingu surface-water dataset maps river extent between Iriri and Pimental before and after operation of the Belo Monte hydropower complex in Brazil. The research team publishes classifications derived from RapidEye imagery for 2011 and PlanetScope imagery for 2019. Figshare provides both shapefile and GeoTIFF products in UTM zone 22S, WGS84, as freely accessible ZIP files under CC BY 4.0. These spatial snapshots can help check simulations of reservoir and river-inundation representations in hydropower or environmental-flow studies. They describe classified surface water, not measured discharge, bathymetry or generation. Differences in image sensors and observation dates introduce uncertainty when interpreting change. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Multi-temporal Xingu river classification - Iriri to Pimental
